narrative:
No non-compliant items were identified on this inspection. The inspection and exit briefing were conducted with the 
applicant. 
 
Applicants must demonstrate that all locations, animals, facilities, vehicles, and equipment comply with the Animal 
Welfare Act before obtaining a license. 
 
We will send a copy of your license within 30 days, unless additional review is required. If you have not heard from us 
within 30 days, contact USDA at 970-494-7478. 
 
Conducting regulated activities without a valid USDA license is a violation of the Animal Welfare Act. 
 
You may appeal any inspection report to the Deputy Administrator. You must submit your appeal of a licensing inspection 
report within 7 days of receipt and all other inspection reports within 21 days of receipt. 
 
Submit your appeal to AnimalCare@usda.gov or:
